logo_override.validation_detail:
Probed: HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, Content-Length 17234 bytes (curl -I with browser UA; plain curl UA gets 403, so the default webfetch path is the reliable probe here). SVG is 246x77 viewBox 0 0 246 77, a single with style="fill:#15234a" -> dark navy wordmark, safe on white; NOT white-on-transparent. Three independent confirmations on the awarding body's own domain: (1) schema.org ld+json WebSite.publisher.logo ImageObject = this exact URL at 246x77, matching the SVG's own width/height; (2) the Drupal branding block
on both the homepage and the shard's target 491 page renders inside ; (3) webfetch returned real SVG markup (paths spelling UNU + WIDER), not an HTML error page. Served from wider.unu.edu's own theme directory - no third-party CDN or mirror. First-party header mark for both records.
logo_override._award: United Nations University World Institute for Development Economics Research (UNU-WIDER)

notes: One host-level logo serves both records; no per-record logo search needed. Path: read shard -> webfetch homepage HTML (markup scan) -> webfetch the asset -> webfetch target 491 page to confirm the same branding block on a record page -> curl -I for content-type/length. Rejected alternates on this host: /favicons/favicon.ico, /favicons/favicon-16x16.png, /favicons/favicon-32x32.png, /favicons/apple-touch-icon.png (favicons, not the mark) and /themes/custom/unuwidertheme/images/feedback-small.png ('Join the network' promo button). The programme artwork collage_leenisversion3.png on target 491 is a content photo, not a logo. Note: wider.unu.edu returns 403 to curl/webfetch with a default user agent but serves fine with a browser UA, so a 403 here is a WAF artifact and not evidence of a missing asset.
